svg.text: SVG Rendering Pipeline — Complete Stage Overview
Thread Swimlanes • Passes (P1–P4) • Key Functions • Purpose per Pass • What Values Exist
▸ Purpose: Build SVG DOM tree with uuid; parse & store width/height
▸ Purpose: Compute display, width, height via Stylo for each element
▸ Purpose: Classify each element's display; dispatch SVG as Replaced
Recurse children → handle_element() for box generation
▸ Purpose: Compute natural dimensions; queue SVG for P2 serialization
Parse width/height → ratio → NaturalSizes { width:200, height:200, ratio:1.0 }
▸ Purpose: Bridge layout → script: pick up queued SVGs to serialize
▸ Values: Script picks up queued SVG, calls serialize_and_cache_subtree()
▸ Purpose: Serialize SVG subtree → base64 data URL; cache for layout
▸ Values: data: URL cached in SVGSVGElement, dirty flag set → reflow
▸ Purpose: Request image from cache with data URL; miss → retry later
▸ Values: source=url exists but not in cache → no Fragment → reflow
▸ Purpose: Store decoded VectorImage from data URL in image cache
▸ Purpose: Decode SVG XML → rasterize → pixel buffer for rendering
Lock store → get usvg Tree → check rasterized cache (miss)
▸ Values: RasterImage cached at (image_id, size). Returns None (async).
▸ On re-entry: rasterized_cache HIT → returns Some(RasterImage)
▸ Purpose: Retrieve cached VectorImage; produce image for fragment
▸ Purpose: Build Fragment::Image with image_key; final display list
▸ Values: Fragment::Image { rect:200×200, image_key } → Display List
P1 → (queue) → P2 (serialize) → reflow → P3 (source=url, cached_image=None → no Fragment) → reflow → ... → P4 (cached_image=Some(Vector) → rasterize → Fragment::Image)
svg_kind_size() is the central function: it runs in P1/P3/P4 and behaves differently based on source + cached_image values
Key Values Through the Pipeline — What Exists at Each Pass
ElementData.styles=Arc<ComputedValues>✅ (display:inline, width/height resolved), cached until mutation
P1 (Pass 1) — First layout, DOM → style → replaced content dispatch. source=None, queues serialization.
P2 (Pass 2) — SVG subtree serialization in Script thread. Produces data: URL in cache.
P3 (Pass 3) — Cache wait: source=url but not in image cache → no Fragment, triggers reflow.
P4 (Pass 4) — Final: vector_image available → rasterize → Fragment::Image → painted on screen.
